content: AP-4 complex subunit mu-1 is a protein encoded by the AP4M1 gene in humans. This gene produces a protein that serves as a subunit of the heterotetrameric AP-4 complex. The protein is classified as a member of the adaptor complexes medium subunits family. The AP-4 complex is specifically responsible for recognizing and sorting cargo proteins that contain tyrosine-based motifs. This sorting process occurs as proteins are transported from the trans-Golgi network to the endosomal-lysosomal system. The AP4M1 protein has been demonstrated to interact with another protein, AP4B1, which is a component of the same AP-4 complex. The trafficking mediated by the AP-4 complex is critically important for proper brain development and function.
